tagline: A story-driven FPS rooted in Puerto Rico. Skill, survival, and what you choose to record.
oneSentence: DTRT AFTERLIGHT is an original Windows FPS campaign in development, with a readable Volume One and an internal first-bullet training range. There is no public download.
statusDetail: Windows Unreal Engine 5. Internal range lab is the playable slice today. The campaign is not a public demo. Volume One of the story is readable on this site.
languages: Spanish in Volume One dialogue and radio titles

features.title: Campaign and story
features.today: Volume One (9,489 words) is complete and public. The playable campaign is not released.
features.blurb: Gabriel Vélez, Añasco, 2032. A radio. A call that should not be possible. The island remembers.

features.title: Combat and movement
features.today: First-bullet credit law is implemented on the internal training range. Campaign encounters are not public.
features.blurb: Move, stop, earn the shot. A walking head never counts.

features.title: Puerto Rican locations
features.today: Story stills and a regional route exist on the site. These are not complete playable maps.
features.blurb: Añasco, Mayagüez, Cabo Rojo, Rincón, and the road east. Interiors invented. Regions real.

features.title: Training
features.today: Internal 12 m range: acquire, still, first bullet, UNIT 12. Access is request-only. Not a public trainer download.
features.blurb: Practice, review, find a weakness, train it, retest. Original rifle: Kestrel.

features.title: Discoveries and music
features.today: Afterlight radio cuts play on this site. In-game radios and unlocks are not verified as a public feature.
features.blurb: Optional finds and a modest broadcast. Not an open-world checklist.

updates.title: Site tracks the campaign, not only the range
updates.canExperience: Read Afterlight Volume One. Play Afterlight radio on the site. Request access for the internal Windows range.
updates.inDevelopment: Playable campaign island, public demo, and in-game radios as unlocks.
updates.body: Public pages now name DTRT AFTERLIGHT as the campaign. Training remains real and request-only. No Steam page, no public build, no invented player counts.

updates.title: Internal range lab
updates.canExperience: First-bullet credit on the internal 12 m range (not a public download).
updates.body: UE 5.8 range remains the verified playable slice. Human-play of a public demo is not available.

faq.a: A story-driven FPS campaign in development, set in Puerto Rico, under the DTRT Lab parent identity. Training is part of the game, not the whole product.
There is no public download. Request access and wait for a yes. Volume One of the story is readable now.

faq.q: Is it only an aim trainer?
faq.a: No. The public story, world stills, and radio exist alongside an internal first-bullet range. The campaign is not finished.

faq.q: Is it CS2, Valorant, or Tarkov?
faq.a: No. Original game, original rifle (Kestrel), original map work. Not a clone, overlay, or cheat.
Not claimed. The story follows a regional route. No public multiplayer.
Store and preorder are off. Ko-fi is support, not a key.
